ValidationRule.description: This rule makes sure the Mobile Number field follows a prescribed format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ER_Business_Unit__c ='BENELUX', NOT(REGEX( MobilePhone,"(^$)|^[+]?([0-9]*[/\\.\\s\\-\\(\\)]|[0-9]+){3,24}$")), NOT( $Profile.Name = "Integration Profile"), NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in a valid Mobile Phone number.
